# Anne Shirley & Paul Irving

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — teacher and student fast friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — pupil in her school · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from school enjoying the autumn day until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses he trapped her there and lied about it, but breaks down when he realizes lying is wrong, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish and educate him.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> In a miserable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to explode in the stove and losing her temper enough to whip [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. That evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). To Anne's surprise, the punishment earns Anthony's respect, as later confirmed when he behaves pleasantly and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) shares his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

> As the school year ends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the graveyard with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), discussing his mother's memory, his life with his grandmother, and their imaginative worlds. At the graveyard, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves flowers for [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) before walking home with Mrs. Allan, who offers encouraging advice about teaching, ideals, and friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P33](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0033)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while his grandmother is away, having tea with him and listening to his imaginative thoughts. Later at home, she puts a jealous [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and reassures him of her affection. Afterwards, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how mature he has become.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_
